subject: Geopolitics
title: New Arms Race Risks
description: A quick, practical guide to New Arms Race Risks.

hook.text: China is building 300 new missile silos. Russia deploys hypersonic weapons. The US modernizes its entire arsenal.

buildup.text: After decades of reduction, nuclear arsenals are expanding again. Arms control treaties are expiring or dead.

discovery.text: A three-way arms race between the US, Russia, and China is harder to manage than the Cold War's two-player game.

twist.text: China refuses arms control talks, saying it needs parity first. But parity is a moving target as others build too.

climax.text: Without new agreements, the world may return to Cold War arsenal levels. This time with three players, not two.

punchline.text: The arms race paused. It never really stopped.

quiz.question: Why is a three-way arms race harder to manage?
options: Three nations have more weapons than two
Bilateral treaties cannot balance three parties
The third nation always has the strongest weapons
